items.pText: This combination reverses the mix of our other twister set: two seated waist-twist stations and one standing station on a single frame. It is the better choice where most users are older adults who prefer to sit, such as a senior citizens' corner in a park or a society garden near the lift lobby. Users hold the handle and turn the hips side to side, a low-impact movement that loosens the lower back. The 2 Seating Cum 1 Standing Twister comes in Play Orange and is part of our Fun Fitness outdoor gym range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. Our standard terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. We can place it on your open gym layout.

Seated twisters need a firm, level base so the seats turn freely and do not rock. We install the frame self-standing or grouted. Keep the turning seats clear of benches and plant beds, check the bearings for play every few months, and replace any worn seat fixings promptly.
